# Albany Junk Removal

> Locally owned, fully insured junk removal and cleanout service in Albany, Oregon, serving homes and businesses across the Mid-Willamette Valley with fast, affordable, responsible hauling.

## Services

Albany Junk Removal removes almost anything — no job is too big or too small:

- **Furniture removal** — couches, sofas, tables, chairs, dressers.
- **Mattress removal** — mattresses and box springs, any size.
- **Appliance removal** — refrigerators, stoves, dishwashers, and more.
- **Washer & dryer removal.**
- **Hot tub removal** — disassembly and haul-away of old spas.
- **Garage cleanouts.**
- **Storage unit cleanouts.**
- **Estate cleanouts** — full-property clearing.
- **Office cleanouts** — desks, cubicles, and commercial junk.
- **Construction debris removal** — remodel and demolition debris.
- **Yard waste removal** — branches, brush, and green debris.
- **Scrap metal removal** — picked up and recycled.
- **General household junk.**

## Why Albany Junk Removal

- Fast response times — often same-day or next-day pickup.
- Honest, upfront pricing — you approve the price before work begins.
- Friendly, professional, uniformed crews.
- Fully insured on every job.
- Responsible disposal — items donated and recycled whenever possible.
- No hidden fees.

## How it works

1. Request a free quote by phone, text, or the online form.
2. The crew confirms an honest, upfront price.
3. They do all the lifting and haul it away.
4. They sweep up and dispose of everything responsibly.

## Pricing

Priced by how much space items take up in the truck — you only pay for what you throw out, with the price confirmed upfront before any work starts. Free, no-obligation quotes.

## Service area

Albany, Corvallis, Lebanon, Tangent, Millersburg, Jefferson, Sweet Home, Philomath, Brownsville, and the Salem area, Oregon.
